name: NTMiner Pool
description: NTMiner Pool is a global mining pool from the Open-Source Miner family, offering low-latency infrastructure, 24/7 technical monitoring, and a PPS+ payout model for stable and optimized returns. With years of blockchain R&D, it provides consistent hashrate performance and supports a wide range of GPU- and ASIC-minable coins.
short_description: NTMiner Pool delivers stable PPS+ mining with global infrastructure and 24/7 monitoring
